messages:
Noah Green: Autopay failed for HorizonDx (acct-HDX) on INV-3002 ($32,400). Gateway decline = expired_card. Customer just messaged asking if they can split payment: partial card charge for current usage and remainder via same-day wire.

Aisha Khan: pulled gateway event: decline_code=expired_card. Customer's PM token still exists but card expiry old. If we accept split pay we need to be careful about partial invoicing and preventing double charge when autopay retries.

Carlos Mendes: Quick ops note: Stripe supports multiple payment intents per invoice but our billing UI doesn't surface split payments well. We can: (A) create two invoices (one for X amount) and process card on the smaller invoice plus accept wire for rest; or (B) accept a card authorization for partial amount and create pending wire for remainder. Need finance sign-off on workflow.

Noah Green: Customer says they'd like to charge $10k to the card now and wire the remaining $22,400 today. They can provide MT103 trace. They asked if service will remain uninterrupted during reconciliation.

billing-bot: Autopay retry policy: next attempt in 24h (attempts remaining: 2). Standard dunning emails queued.

Aisha Khan: Proposal: (1) Pause autopay retries/dunning; (2) Create a new invoice INV-3002-SPLIT for $10,000 and attempt card charge after CS tokenizes new card if needed; (3) Mark original INV-3002 as pending_wire for $22,400; (4) Only release service hold when wire trace matches bank feed. Finance must confirm temporary credit policy if wire delay occurs.

Carlos Mendes: Operational constraints: We cannot apply partial capture to an existing single invoice without splitting it in our ledger. Splitting keeps reconciliation simple. Will need to generate credit memo/partial invoice. Also make sure tax/VAT lines remain consistent.

Noah Green: Finance, can we approve this split flow? Customer contract allows partial payment if cleared with finance and CS. They need confirmation within 30 minutes to instruct their bank.

Aisha Khan: Recommend approving split with conditions: (a) CS must upload MT103 before we mark paid; (b) pause autopay; (c) create pending_wire state; (d) Finance can allow a $5k temporary service credit only if we see outbound trace and bank reconciliation pending. No automatic service restoration without matching bank feed.

Carlos Mendes: I'll prepare the split invoice and a single-use hosted card link for $10k if they want card-on-file. Link expires in 6 hours. If customer prefers to provide new card details we must use 3DS flow.

Noah Green: Customer prefers card charge now via hosted link. I'll send link and request MT103 for the wire; they confirmed they'll initiate wire as soon as we confirm split approach.

billing-bot: Action: pause dunning; set INV-3002 flag=split_payment_pending. Autopay retries paused.

Banking Ops: Wire template and account details shared via secure channel. Please instruct customer to include reference INV-3002 / HDX. We will monitor inbound wires.

Aisha Khan: Reminder: update CRM with both payment references and set two ledger entries: INV-3002-SPLIT (paid by card) and INV-3002 (pending_wire). I'll coordinate tax lines.

Noah Green: Sent hosted link to customer: https://pay.redwood.com/t/SPLT9 (single-use, $10,000). They say their bank will send MT103 within 1 hour.

Carlos Mendes: Noted. Will not attempt any autopay captures against original invoice. Once card payment clears, I'll apply payment to split invoice and leave pending_wire for remainder.

Aisha Khan: Finance approves split with the conditions above. No late fee waiver needed. Approving up to $5k temporary service safety credit if bank shows outbound trace but beneficiary not yet reconciled.

Noah Green: Customer uploaded MT103 trace to finance-wires@redwood.com at 14:22 UTC. They also confirmed hosted card payment completed; awaiting authorization confirmation.

billing-bot: Hosted payment intent confirmed: pi_SPLT_01 succeeded. INV-3002-SPLIT marked paid. INV-3002 status updated: pending_wire. Dunning suppressed.

Carlos Mendes: Card payment applied to INV-3002-SPLIT. Waiting on bank feed to reconcile wire for $22,400. I'll remove hold and close thread when settled.

Noah Green: Thanks team. I'll keep thread updated once reconciliation completes. :white_check_mark:
